verdict.rationale: Shopify POS documents an official POS UI extensions API on shopify.dev for adding custom functionality to the POS interface. It has defined targets (tiles, actions, blocks), runtime APIs such as shopify.storage, shopify.toast and shopify.action.presentModal(), Shopify CLI scaffolding, and direct GraphQL Admin API access. Together these form an official SDK developers can build against. Missing for 10: explicit SDK package/language and versioning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: With Shopify POS UI extensions, you can add custom functionality directly into Shopify's point-of-sale interface.
Use Shopify CLI to scaffold your extension with the essential configuration and files.
shopify.storage persists data between sessions, shopify.toast displays feedback messages, and shopify.action.presentModal() launches full-screen workflows.
Extensions can also query the GraphQL Admin API directly using standard fetch() calls.
